g.text: SD02 — Perform Action in Natural Language (UC02, UC05, UC06, UC14; F02, F05, F06; Facade, Command)
(n1) In dialogue mode the view calls sendDialogue() instead (SD07). Buttons and map clicks call performAction(proposal), which skips interpret() and narrate() (SD10, SD11, SD12).
:CliGameView can take the place of :SwingGameView in every diagram.
(n2) narration = the error text, results = [], gameOver = false

(n3) Only typed commands are narrated, including ones the engine refused. The narration is shown IN ADDITION to the engine's own result text, not in place of it, and it is not stored in the event log or the memory.
(n4) Narrator allows at most one retry. If the check still fails (or the model is unavailable) the template is used: the engine's result text. The notice appears at most once per turn.
(LLM returns JSON actions, e.g. take "iron key", move NORTH;
returns no proposals if the text matches no known pattern)
fallback after at most one retry: template = the engine's result text)
